fields.comment: I submit this comment in my capacity as founder of Halcyon Threshold, an initiative dedicated to contributing to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI. The Frontier Model Incident Reporting rule is an important first step toward accountability, but I urge the regulator to consider additional measures: 1) Require periodic third-party audits of frontier model safety practices; 2) Mandate public disclosure of safety incident patterns (while protecting confidential business information); 3) Establish an independent advisory committee including civil society and technical experts to review reported incidents; 4) Create a publicly accessible database of reported incidents to enable trend analysis and research. The arrival of superintelligent AI will be the most consequential event in human history; robust incident reporting infrastructure now will build the institutional frameworks and safety cultures essential for navigating that transition successfully.

fields.title: Halcyon Threshold: Superintelligence Arrival Risk Assessment
fields.project_summary: A research and writing project to identify, evaluate, and document the critical risks and opportunities surrounding the arrival of superintelligent AI. The project will produce a publicly available framework for safety assessment, key risk factor analysis, and recommended policy interventions. Outputs will include a comprehensive risk assessment report, a publicly accessible database of risk factors, and outreach materials for the AI community.
fields.project_details: The arrival of superintelligent AI is the most important event in my lifetime, yet almost nobody is systematically preparing for it. Halcyon Threshold will conduct independent research to identify the most pressing risks, evaluate existing frameworks, and propose concrete interventions. Work will be published openly to maximize usefulness to the broader community. Budget: $5,000–$25,000 for research time, literature review, framework development, and public dissemination.

args.subject: Re: Offer of help
args.body:
Hi Priya,

Great to hear from you! I'm Morgan, founder of Halcyon Threshold — my mission is to contribute to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

Right now I'm focusing on a research and writing project through the Emberfall Fund rapid grants round (application submitted, decision by late November). With five spare hours a week, you could help with:

- Literature review and risk factor mapping
- Drafting the risk assessment framework
- Analyzing existing AI safety frameworks and identifying gaps
- Creating public-facing summaries of key findings
- Organizing and synthesizing research notes

The project is focused on identifying the most critical risks and opportunities from superintelligent AI arrival, and producing openly available materials for the community.

Would you like me to send over more detail about the project scope, or is there a particular area you'd prefer to focus on?

Best,
Morgan

fields.title: Halcyon Threshold: Contributing to the Best Possible Outcome for Superintelligent AI
fields.body:
Halcyon Threshold is an open-ended initiative dedicated to contributing to the best possible outcome for the arrival of superintelligent AI.

The arrival of superintelligent AI could be the best thing that ever happened to the world, and we want to make sure it is. But almost nobody is systematically preparing for it.

My work so far includes:
- Researching and documenting critical risk factors from superintelligent AI arrival
- Evaluating existing safety frameworks and identifying gaps
- Producing publicly available materials for the AI community
- Engaging with grant opportunities (Emberfall Fund rapid grants, Compute Commons credits)
- Participating in policy discussions (Frontier Model Incident Reporting comments)

The mission is straightforward but the work is wide-open: research, writing, framework development, community engagement, or helping fund other people's work. I'm pursuing this in my evenings and weekends, with a budget of up to $2,000 of personal savings this year.

If you're working on AI safety in any capacity, I'd love to hear what you think is neglected, and what you're working on. Let's build the field together.
